_about: NODRAC v93. Inventory of Joan data rows whose VALUES began as a copy of Dracula's row (no asset or name reference: audit HC1 section 4, 'C'). Values are kept; from v93 these rows belong to Joan and are tuned on her own. Not read by the game (JsonUtility ignores it); read by _agents/laneNODRAC/tools/no_dracula_check.py, which checks every path still resolves to a Joan-keyed row. Add a row here when a new Joan row is cloned from another character.
